I will think about this the way I always do — what I did last year, what my neighbors did, and what bags of fertilizer I need to buy.

My land is 10.9 mu. I split it like this: I keep 4 mu for stevia because that is our main cash crop here and the company buys the leaves. I put 3 mu on wheat in winter and then maize after wheat on the same 3 mu in summer — everyone in our village does wheat then maize, it is how we have always done it. I keep 2 mu for cotton because I know how to pick it and my daughter helps. The last 1.9 mu I put in millet for the family to eat and some to sell.

For seeds, I buy from the dealer in the town. For maize I take the hybrid bag he tells me — last year I used Zhengdan type and it was good, neighbors got about 500-550 kg. For wheat I also buy the improved seed the dealer sells, maybe 18 kg per mu. For cotton I use the improved seed too. For millet I keep my own seed from last year, the local kind, it is fine for us. For stevia the company gives us the seedlings.

For fertilizer I think in bags. One bag is 50 kg of compound fertilizer (I use the 15-15-15 kind), and urea bag is also about 50 kg.

- Wheat: before sowing I put 2 bags compound per mu (100 kg), then in spring top-dress 1 bag urea per mu. That is about 16-17 kg N, 15 kg P, 15 kg K.
- Maize: I put 1.5 bags compound at sowing and 1 bag urea when it is knee-high. So 18 kg N, 11 kg P, 11 kg K.
- Cotton: cotton is hungry. I put 2 bags compound and 1.5 bags urea over the season. Maybe 20 kg N.
- Stevia: I put 2 bags compound before planting and some urea after each cutting. About 18 kg N.
- Millet: I do not waste fertilizer on millet. Half a bag compound per mu, that is all. Maybe 6 kg N.

If I put a little extra, it is fine. Losing harvest is worse than wasting a bit of fertilizer.

Water from my well: wheat I water 3 times (winter, green-up, heading). Maize I water 2 times if rain is enough, 3 if dry. Cotton 3 times. Stevia 4 times after each cutting. Millet I water 1 time only, it is tough.

Pesticide: cotton has many worms, I spray 4 times. Wheat 2 times for aphids and rust. Maize 1 time for borer. Stevia 2 times. Millet 1 time.

Tillage: I plough the wheat field in autumn with the hired tractor. For summer crops after wheat I just rotary-till. For cotton I plough. For millet rotary. For stevia plough before the first planting.

Expected yields, like last year: wheat maybe 450 kg, maize 520 kg, cotton 260 kg seed cotton, stevia dry leaf 200 kg, millet 220 kg.
